vr.look: A newcomer comes to live in a new country. Long ago, many came by steamship past the Statue of Liberty, a symbol of welcome.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Steam in Filter environments. Click Immigrant Steam Ship (Dusk), then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the ship
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Walk along the deck. Look at where people would stand, sleep and wait. Look out at the water.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until the deck fits.

Click Record video. Say your 2 sentences. Click it again to stop.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Record a new video and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Look out over the rail while you record, like a newcomer watching for the new country.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, that shows the ship while you say both sentences.

place.alt: The Statue of Liberty on a small island in a harbor
place.html: What newcomers saw: the Statue of Liberty in New York Harbor. It stands for welcome.
place.cap: The Statue of Liberty, New York Harbor.

say: This is a ship that carried newcomers, and I see ___.
The Statue of Liberty stands for ___.

studio.title: Peek and Name It
studio.look: Four pictures hide under 9 tiles each. Each picture is a kind of evidence about our country: a symbol, a document or an event.
studio.do: Tap a tile to peek. Name the picture as soon as you know. Fewer tiles is better!

game.miss: Not that one. Peek at another tile.
game.done: All four named! Symbols, documents and events each tell part of our country's story.

rounds.alt: The Stars and Stripes flying on a flagpole
rounds.ok: Yes! The flag is a symbol. Its 50 stars stand for the 50 states.

rounds.alt: An old page of handwriting with big letters at the top
rounds.ok: Yes! The Constitution is a document. It says what the country promises.

rounds.alt: The Statue of Liberty on an island
rounds.ok: Yes! The Statue of Liberty is a symbol of welcome.

rounds.alt: A voting booth with a red curtain
rounds.ok: Yes! Election Day is an event. Each voter gets one vote.

frames.lead: Pick one symbol. What does it stand for?
frames.starter: The ... is a symbol that stands for ...

frames.lead: Which picture tells our story best?
frames.starter: The picture that tells our story best is ... because ...

studio.full: All four pictures are named, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
